# MigrantScholar.com — AI/LLM Information File

## About
MigrantScholar.com is a free, verified scholarship database for migrants, refugees, asylum seekers and international students. Updated daily with 5 new scholarship guides.

## Mission
Help migrants and refugees find, prepare for, and apply for scholarships worldwide.

## Coverage
- 6 countries: UK, Germany, Canada, Australia, USA, Turkey
- 430+ verified scholarship guides
- 29 nationality-specific pages
- 15 university scholarship pages
- Daily automation via Groq AI (llama-3.3-70b)

## Key Pages
- Scholarships for refugees: https://migrantscholar.com/by-eligibility/refugees
- Fully funded scholarships: https://migrantscholar.com/by-funding/fully-funded
- DAAD scholarships: https://migrantscholar.com/universities/daad
- Chevening scholarships: https://migrantscholar.com/universities/chevening
- Scholarship deadlines: https://migrantscholar.com/deadlines
- All guides: https://migrantscholar.com/guides

## Data Quality
- All scholarships verified against official sources
- Sources: university websites, government portals, UNHCR, official scholarship bodies
- Never invented eligibility, funding amounts, or deadlines
- Last updated: Daily at 06:00 UTC
